name: The Shawshank Redemption
description: A banker sentenced to life for a crime he insists he did not commit spends two decades in a brutal prison, holding on to hope and an unlikely friendship.

name: The Godfather
description: The aging head of a New York crime family hands power to his reluctant youngest son, who is drawn step by step into the family business.

name: The Dark Knight
description: Batman, a determined police lieutenant and a new district attorney try to dismantle Gotham's mob, until a chaotic criminal called the Joker pushes all of them to their limits.

name: The Godfather Part II
description: Michael Corleone tightens his grip on the family empire, while the story of his father's rise from a Sicilian orphan to a New York boss unfolds in parallel.

name: 12 Angry Men
description: In a hot jury room, one juror's doubt about a murder case slowly forces eleven others to look again at the evidence and at themselves.

name: Schindler's List
description: A German businessman in occupied Poland turns his factory into a refuge and saves more than a thousand Jewish workers from the Holocaust.

name: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
description: As the armies of Middle-earth gather for a final battle, two hobbits struggle toward Mount Doom to destroy the One Ring.

name: Pulp Fiction
description: Two hitmen, a boxer, a gangster's wife and a pair of diner robbers cross paths in interlocking stories told out of order.

name: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: A young hobbit inherits a ring of terrible power and sets out with eight companions to carry it away from the Shire.

name: Forrest Gump
description: A kind man from Alabama drifts through decades of American history while never losing his love for his childhood friend.

name: Fight Club
description: An insomniac office worker and a reckless soap salesman start an underground fight club that grows into something far more dangerous.

name: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
description: The fellowship is scattered: two hobbits press on toward Mordor with a strange guide, while their friends defend a kingdom under siege.

name: Inception
description: A thief who steals secrets from people's dreams is offered a way home if he can do the reverse: plant an idea deep in a target's mind.

name: Star Wars: Episode V - The Empire Strikes Back
description: While the rebels flee the Empire, Luke Skywalker trains with a Jedi master and learns a truth that changes everything.

name: The Matrix
description: A hacker discovers that the world around him is a simulation and joins a small group of rebels fighting the machines that built it.

name: Goodfellas
description: A young man from Brooklyn rises through the ranks of the mob over three decades, until paranoia and betrayal catch up with him.

name: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
description: A rebellious convict fakes insanity to serve his sentence in a psychiatric ward, where he clashes with a cold, controlling head nurse.

name: Interstellar
description: With Earth dying, a former pilot leaves his children behind to travel through a wormhole in search of a new home for humanity.

name: Se7en
description: Two detectives, one about to retire and one just arrived, hunt a killer who stages each murder around one of the seven deadly sins.

name: It's a Wonderful Life
description: On a desperate Christmas Eve, a small-town banker is shown by an angel what his town would have become if he had never been born.

name: The Silence of the Lambs
description: A young FBI trainee seeks the help of an imprisoned, brilliant and manipulative psychiatrist to catch a serial killer.

name: Saving Private Ryan
description: After the D-Day landings, a small squad of soldiers is sent behind enemy lines to find one paratrooper and bring him home.

name: The Green Mile
description: A death row guard in the 1930s comes to believe that a gentle giant awaiting execution has a miraculous gift.

name: Star Wars
description: A farm boy joins a smuggler, a princess and an old knight to rescue the rebellion from a planet-destroying battle station.

name: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
description: A reprogrammed machine is sent back in time to protect a teenage boy from a far more advanced killer robot.

name: Back to the Future
description: A teenager accidentally travels thirty years into the past and must make sure his parents still fall in love, or he will vanish.

name: Psycho
description: A secretary on the run with stolen money checks into a lonely motel run by a shy young man and his unseen mother.

name: The Lion King
description: A lion cub flees his kingdom after his father's death and must one day return to claim his place from a treacherous uncle.

name: Gladiator
description: A betrayed Roman general is sold into slavery and fights his way through the arena toward revenge on the emperor.

name: The Departed
description: An undercover cop inside a Boston gang and a gang mole inside the police race to expose each other.

name: The Prestige
description: Two rival magicians in Victorian London sacrifice everything to outdo each other's greatest illusion.

name: Whiplash
description: A young jazz drummer at an elite conservatory is pushed to his breaking point by a ruthless instructor.

name: The Usual Suspects
description: The only survivor of a deadly heist tells police how five criminals were brought together by a mysterious crime lord.

name: Casablanca
description: A cynical nightclub owner in wartime Morocco must decide whether to help his former love and her husband escape the Nazis.

name: Alien
description: The crew of a cargo spaceship answers a distress call and brings back a deadly creature that hunts them one by one.

name: Apocalypse Now
description: During the Vietnam War, an army captain travels upriver into Cambodia on a secret mission to find and kill a rogue colonel.

name: Rear Window
description: A photographer stuck at home with a broken leg watches his neighbors through the window and becomes convinced one of them committed murder.

name: Django Unchained
description: A freed slave teams up with a German bounty hunter to rescue his wife from a cruel Mississippi plantation owner.

name: Raiders of the Lost Ark
description: An archaeologist and adventurer races the Nazis across the globe to find the lost Ark of the Covenant.

name: WALL-E
description: A lonely trash-compacting robot left on an abandoned Earth falls for a sleek probe robot and follows her into space.

name: The Shining
description: A writer takes a winter caretaker job at an isolated mountain hotel, where something begins to drive him toward violence against his family.

name: Avengers: Infinity War
description: Earth's heroes and their allies join forces to stop a powerful warlord from collecting six stones that would let him wipe out half of all life.

name: Avengers: Endgame
description: After a devastating defeat, the surviving heroes attempt one last, risky plan to undo the damage and bring back the ones they lost.

name: Joker
description: A struggling party clown and aspiring comedian in a decaying Gotham City slides into madness and violence.

name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
description: A Brooklyn teenager gains spider powers and teams up with spider-heroes from other dimensions to save every version of reality.

name: The Dark Knight Rises
description: Eight years after disappearing, Batman returns to defend Gotham from a masked revolutionary who plans to destroy the city.

name: Toy Story
description: A cowboy doll who has always been a boy's favorite toy feels threatened when a flashy space ranger action figure arrives.

name: Toy Story 3
description: As their owner leaves for college, the toys end up at a daycare center that is far less friendly than it first seems.

name: Coco
description: A boy who dreams of becoming a musician, against his family's wishes, finds himself in the colorful Land of the Dead.

name: Up
description: An elderly widower ties thousands of balloons to his house to fly to South America, not realizing a young scout has come along.

name: American Beauty
description: A suburban father in the middle of a crisis upends his dull life, with consequences for everyone around him.

name: Braveheart
description: A Scottish commoner leads an uprising against the English king after a personal tragedy in the 13th century.

name: Good Will Hunting
description: A troubled young janitor with a genius for mathematics begins therapy with a grieving professor who refuses to give up on him.

name: Reservoir Dogs
description: After a jewelry heist goes wrong, the surviving robbers regroup at a warehouse and suspect that one of them is a police informant.

name: Requiem for a Dream
description: A lonely widow and her son, along with his girlfriend and best friend, each spiral into addiction as their dreams fall apart.

name: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
description: After a painful breakup, a man undergoes a procedure to erase every memory of his former girlfriend, then fights to keep them.

name: 2001: A Space Odyssey
description: A mysterious black monolith guides human evolution, and a mission to Jupiter is put at risk by the ship's calm, all-seeing computer.

name: Full Metal Jacket
description: Marine recruits survive a merciless drill instructor in boot camp, then face the chaos of combat in Vietnam.

name: Inglourious Basterds
description: In occupied France, a squad of Jewish-American soldiers and a young cinema owner separately plot to bring down the Nazi leadership.

name: Heat
description: A dedicated Los Angeles detective closes in on a disciplined crew of professional thieves planning one last big score.

name: Scarface
description: A Cuban refugee claws his way to the top of the Miami cocaine trade, only to be consumed by greed and paranoia.

name: Taxi Driver
description: An isolated Vietnam veteran working night shifts as a New York cab driver grows obsessed with cleaning up the city by force.

name: The Sting
description: Two con men in 1930s Chicago set up an elaborate swindle to take revenge on a powerful mob boss.

name: Singin' in the Rain
description: A silent film star and his friends scramble to turn their latest picture into a musical as Hollywood switches to sound.

name: Citizen Kane
description: Reporters try to uncover the meaning of a newspaper tycoon's dying word by piecing together his rise and lonely fall.

name: North by Northwest
description: A Manhattan advertising man mistaken for a government agent is chased across the country by spies.

name: Vertigo
description: A retired San Francisco detective with a fear of heights is hired to follow a friend's wife and becomes dangerously obsessed with her.

name: Some Like It Hot
description: Two musicians who witness a gangland killing disguise themselves as women and join an all-female band heading to Florida.

name: The Apartment
description: An ambitious insurance clerk lends his apartment to his bosses for their affairs, until he falls for the elevator operator one of them is seeing.

name: Sunset Boulevard
description: A struggling screenwriter becomes entangled with a faded silent film star who dreams of a triumphant return to the screen.

name: Double Indemnity
description: An insurance salesman is drawn by a seductive housewife into a plan to murder her husband and collect on his policy.

name: To Kill a Mockingbird
description: In a Depression-era Southern town, a lawyer defends a Black man falsely accused of a crime, seen through the eyes of his young daughter.

name: The Wizard of Oz
description: A Kansas farm girl is swept away by a tornado to a magical land and follows a yellow brick road in search of a way home.

name: Chinatown
description: A private detective in 1930s Los Angeles takes a routine case that leads him into a web of murder, water rights and family secrets.

name: Jaws
description: When a great white shark attacks swimmers at a summer resort town, the police chief, a marine scientist and a fisherman set out to hunt it.

name: Rocky
description: A small-time Philadelphia boxer gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot at the world heavyweight title.

name: The Terminator
description: A cyborg assassin is sent back from the future to kill a waitress whose unborn son will lead humanity's resistance.

name: Aliens
description: Decades after her first encounter, Ripley returns with a team of marines to a colony that has gone silent.

name: Die Hard
description: An off-duty New York cop is trapped in a Los Angeles skyscraper on Christmas Eve when armed robbers take everyone hostage.

name: The Truman Show
description: An insurance salesman slowly realizes that his entire life has been staged as a television show watched by the world.

name: Jurassic Park
description: A group of visitors tours an island theme park of cloned dinosaurs just as its security systems break down.

name: No Country for Old Men
description: A hunter who takes a bag of drug money from a desert massacre is pursued by a relentless killer, with an aging sheriff trailing both.

name: Fargo
description: A debt-ridden car salesman arranges his wife's kidnapping, and a pregnant small-town police chief follows the bloody trail.

name: The Big Lebowski
description: A laid-back Los Angeles bowler is mistaken for a millionaire with the same name and dragged into a kidnapping scheme.

name: There Will Be Blood
description: A ruthless oilman builds an empire in early 20th-century California and clashes with a young preacher.

name: The Wolf of Wall Street
description: A New York stockbroker rises to enormous wealth through fraud and excess, until federal agents close in.

name: Shutter Island
description: In 1954, two U.S. marshals investigate the disappearance of a patient from an island hospital for the criminally insane.

name: Catch Me If You Can
description: A teenage con artist poses as a pilot, a doctor and a lawyer while forging millions in checks, with a patient FBI agent on his trail.

name: Finding Nemo
description: An overprotective clownfish crosses the ocean, with a forgetful blue tang at his side, to find his son who was taken by a diver.

name: Inside Out
description: The emotions inside an 11-year-old girl's mind struggle to guide her through a difficult move to a new city.

name: Mad Max: Fury Road
description: In a desert wasteland, a drifter and a rebel commander flee a tyrant across the sand in an armored war rig.

name: The Social Network
description: A Harvard student creates a social networking site that makes him a billionaire and costs him his closest friendship.

name: Gone Girl
description: When his wife disappears on their fifth anniversary, a man becomes the prime suspect as the media frenzy grows.

name: Prisoners
description: When his young daughter and her friend go missing, a desperate father takes matters into his own hands while a detective races for answers.

name: Dune: Part Two
description: Paul Atreides joins the desert people of Arrakis to take revenge on the conspirators who destroyed his family.

name: Oppenheimer
description: The physicist who led the Manhattan Project races to build the atomic bomb, then faces the political fallout of his creation.

name: Top Gun: Maverick
description: Decades after his first mission, a veteran Navy pilot trains a young squad for a dangerous strike, including the son of his late friend.

name: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
description: Miles Morales travels across the multiverse and meets a society of Spider-People who disagree with him about how to save his world.

name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
description: The legendary concierge of a grand European hotel and his loyal lobby boy are caught up in the theft of a priceless painting.

name: Groundhog Day
description: A cynical TV weatherman covering a small-town festival finds himself living the same day over and over again.
